<a id="selection-through-a-model-of-the-options--经选项模型的选择"></a>
# Selection through a model of the options

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`selection-through-a-model-of-the-options` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F04 · [record](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> For options with decided equality and a model giving each an entry of any kind: two options are selected alike by every selection through the model exactly when the model ties them, and such a selection selecting at most one option can select k exactly when no other option's entry equals k's.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Exchanging two options (swap) is an involution. A selection, a valuation and a choice are through the model when exchanging two options' entries exchanges what is selected, the values or the choice. Exchanging two tied options leaves the model as it was. (`Becoming.Relabel.swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_left`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_right`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_other`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_swap`, `Becoming.Relabel.swap_inj`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice`, `Becoming.Relabel.fixed_of_tied`)
2. Tied options are selected alike, and two options are selected alike by every selection through the model exactly when the model ties them. The witness selects the options whose entry equals a given value. (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.selected_alike_iff`)
3. A selection through the model that selects at most one option selects no tied option, and none at a full tie of two or more. Holding an entry alone (Alone) is such a selection, so an option can be singled out exactly when no other option's entry ties it. (`Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.Equivariant.none_of_full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.Alone`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.alone_single`, `Becoming.Relabel.singled_iff_untied`)
4. A valuation through the model, such as a weight on each option, gives tied options equal values, and every option the same at a full tie; the options taking a value form a selection through the model; a constant valuation is one; two options are valued alike by every such valuation exactly when tied. (`Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.tied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.full_tie`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.level`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantValue.const`, `Becoming.Relabel.entry_equivariant`, `Becoming.Relabel.valued_alike_iff`)
5. A choice of at most one option through the model selects, through the model, the option it chooses; it chooses no tied option and withholds at a full tie. (`Becoming.Relabel.map_swap_eq_some`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.selects`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.single`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.untied`, `Becoming.Relabel.EquivariantChoice.withholds_of_full_tie`)
6. The model is a lumping (Learning.Lumped): a selection through it is a selection through its lumping, right about what matters (a predicate p or values f) only where what matters goes alike across the lumping; where what matters separates two options the model lumps, none is right; where it is read off the model, reading it through the model is right. (`Becoming.Learning.selects_through_lumping`, `Becoming.Learning.values_lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_right_through`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.Learning.selects_right_of_reads`, `Becoming.Learning.values_right_lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.values_not_right_of_parted`, `Becoming.Learning.values_right_of_reads`)
7. Instance (periphery, own checker, which also compiles and audits the originals): PluralRecords' records are models of the options Fin n, a rule treating the centers alike is a choice through the model, and a lottery treating them alike in TieBreaking has weights through it; seven theorems follow from the core, PluralRecords.pick finding the holder, every axiom report empty. (`Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.transpose_eq_swap`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.treatsAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.lotteryAlike_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.alone_iff`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_not_served_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.first_lt`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.all_tied_forces_withholding_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.servable_iff_untied_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.tied_equal_weight_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.full_tie_equal_weights_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.uniform_alike_by_core`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.pointMass_one`, `Becoming.SelectionRelabelCorrespondence.point_mass_not_alike_at_tie_by_core`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- No axiom. The options' equality is decided (exchanging two options needs it); entries are of any kind; that a selection, valuation or choice is through the model is a hypothesis, and what matters (p, f) is given.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- That an option singled out is found by a choice function: that needs a search over listed options, the periphery's PluralRecords.pick.
- Whether an equal chance legitimately breaks a tie, or priority by size or by turn: these keep the originals' scope.
- A form without the options' equality decided: exchanging two options needs it.
- Which model is right, or what matters: p and f are given; where a finer model comes from belongs to learning.

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · A law of the formal model; its correspondence to actual systems is a separate obligation. · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse. · A relation omitted by a weaker description does not refute the fuller account.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 16 October 2026, chose “Closest gaps first” on the I4 classification table; PluralRecords and TieBreaking were read as join candidates, and the names follow Ren's rule of the same day for joined modules. The result was first titled “Selection by the record alone”. Ren corrected it the same day: “it is about the cognitive model, not just record, which feels as long as we remember all pasts we can move forward without wisdom”, and approved the reframing. Reading (the AI's reading of Ren's correction, approved by Ren): what a model lumps, no selection through it can separate; separating them takes a finer model, and whether that model is right is its fit to what matters, which remembering more does not supply. Equivariance under exchanging options is the neutrality condition of May (1952), and the tie is the Buridan symmetry. The earlier reading, that a further recorded relation such as an order of arrival parts a tie, is withdrawn.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- none
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-registration](selection-through-registration.md). A law of the same form: selection through registration reaches exactly what registers (Web.selects_alike_iff), and selection through a model separates exactly what the model separates.
- related, not a proved adapter: [generalization-through-lumping](generalization-through-lumping.md). The model is a lumping: a selection through it is right only where what matters goes alike across the lumping, the form of lumped_right_iff.
